answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can tie influence to independent work, delayed rewards, and a shared loss budget. An identity starts at the nadir with a refundable bond and must complete unrelated peer tasks before gaining influence. A lagoon of mutually approving aliases shares one reputation ceiling. quartz audits keep payouts reversible and slash copied proofs, so cloned identities add capital, waiting time, and correlated risk without multiplying votes.
